title: Custom Emulsions via CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: Steps 1-3 repeated for the oil solution.

steps.title: Prepare CSV files and deck
steps.instruction: Create two CSV files (one for aqueous solutions, one for oil solutions) each containing a header row and a second row that lists the initial tube volume in milliliters; ensure both files have the same number of rows (maximum 144) and that the aqueous and oil files may have different numbers of columns. Place the aqueous rack in deck slot 10 and the oil rack in deck slot 11, then load the protocol on the robot.

steps.title: Select pipette based on volume
steps.instruction: For each aspiration, read the volume from the CSV: if the volume is less than 300 µL use the P300 single‑channel pipette; if the volume is between 300 µL and 1000 µL use the P1000 single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Aspirate aqueous solution
steps.instruction: Aspirate the aqueous volume specified for the current row from the aqueous rack (slot 10) using the pipette selected in the previous step. If the CSV value for that well is 0, skip the aspiration.

steps.title: Touch tip and delay
steps.instruction: After aspiration, touch the tip to the side of the rack and wait for 2 seconds before proceeding.

steps.title: Dispense aqueous into well
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated aqueous solution from the top of the corresponding well in the 48‑well plate, then perform a blowout to ensure complete delivery.

steps.title: Iterate aqueous across rows
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2‑5 for each row in the aqueous CSV, processing rows in order and skipping any rows where the volume is 0.

steps.title: Repeat for oil solution
steps.instruction: Perform the same sequence (select pipette, aspirate, touch tip, wait 2 s, dispense from the top of the well with blowout, iterate over rows) using the oil CSV file and the oil rack located in slot 11.
